site.title: Tio's Tortillería · East Austin Food Truck
site.description: A two-person tortilla and taco truck on Cesar Chavez and Pedernales. We make the tortillas. We make the salsa. That is most of the work.
site.author: Beto Reyna
site.tagline: Hand-pressed tortillas. Six tacos. East Austin since 2022.

props.text: 1820 E Cesar Chavez · Wed-Sun · 11a-9p (or until tortillas run out)
Six tacos. Six salsas. Tortillas pressed three feet from where you're standing.

We opened in March 2022 with $14,000, a 1996 Chevy step-van, and a tortilla press that used to belong to my grandmother Esperanza in Matamoros. Three years later we are still on the same corner of East Cesar Chavez and Pedernales. Same press. Same six tacos. Different number of customers.

I'm Beto Reyna. My wife Adriana and I run the truck — that is the whole staff. I'm the cook. She's the front of house, the books, and the reason the truck got painted properly the second time. We grew up in Brownsville, moved to Austin in 2014, and lived for eight years on the wrong side of the river before this corner opened up.

My grandmother Esperanza ran a tortilla shop in Matamoros from 1971 to 2003. I worked there summers between ages eleven and seventeen. She made everything by hand and never once measured a thing. When she passed in 2019 she left me her cast-iron tortilla press, which is the same one we use here. The masa is hers. The salsas are mostly mine. The barbacoa is hers and Adriana's together.

We are not the cheapest taco truck in East Austin. We are also not the fanciest. We make about 320 tortillas on a weekday and 700 on a Saturday and when the masa runs out, we close. We do not use a third-party app. We do not deliver. We are a truck. We are right here.

props.name: Barbacoa
props.features: Slow-cooked beef cheek with our chile guajillo · Fresh corn tortilla pressed to order · Diced white onion + cilantro · Salsa verde de tomatillo on the side · Adriana's recipe

props.name: Carnitas
props.features: Pork shoulder confit'd in lard with orange + bay · Fresh corn tortilla · Pickled red onion + lime · Salsa de chile de árbol · Vegetarian option swaps in mushroom carnitas, same price

props.name: Pescado
props.features: Crispy gulf snapper from Quality Seafood Market · Fresh corn tortilla · Cabbage slaw with lime crema · Salsa macha with peanuts · Best Friday and Saturday when the snapper comes in

props.name: Hongos
props.features: Maitake + oyster mushrooms from Texas Mushrooms (Fredericksburg) · Charred on the plancha with garlic + epazote · Fresh corn tortilla · Salsa verde · Vegan if you skip the queso fresco

props.name: Pollo asado
props.features: Marinated dark-meat chicken from Smith & Smith poultry · Grilled over mesquite · Fresh corn tortilla · Avocado-tomatillo · Cilantro-lime rice on the side

props.name: Tortilla, plain
props.features: Just a tortilla, pressed and griddled while you wait · Take six home for $7 · Best with butter and salt · You will eat one before you get home · We have lost the math on these

props.quote: I work at the auto shop on Lott Avenue. I eat at Tio's three days a week. The carnitas is correct. The barbacoa is correct. Beto knows my order. That's the whole review.
props.author: Hector Pena

props.quote: I grew up in Reynosa. I have been hunting for a tortilla in Texas that tastes like the one my abuela made for fourteen years. Tio's is the closest I have come. I do not know who Esperanza was. I am grateful for her.
props.author: Marisol Cantu

props.quote: We catered our wedding through Tio's in October 2024. 84 guests. They brought the truck. Beto pressed tortillas for three hours. My uncle from Monterrey cried at the salsa. Hire them. Just hire them.
props.author: Wendy & James Calloway

props.quote: I'm vegetarian. The hongos taco is the only taco in this city I would say is genuinely good and not just polite-good. I have brought four people here. They all came back without me.
props.author: Theo Granger

content.heading: Regulars
content.subheading: Pulled from texts and one Google review we did not pay for.

props.text: If you want the truck, we can bring the truck. We do roughly twelve catering events a year and they are usually weddings or birthdays. Minimum 60 guests. We need at least eight weeks notice and a power source within forty feet of where we park. $24 per guest, all in.
Adriana checks email after 10 p.m. when the truck closes. Catering inquiries should include a date, headcount, and a phone number. We always reply.
